title: MOASYS-Vault — warnings.json (and validation-warnings.json, plex-warnings.json, plex-log-warnings.json)
description: The on-disk shape for every warnings file the scanner writes. Warnings are grouped by type under by_type — sparse, only types that fired appear as keys. Rows inside each bucket are sorted alphabetically by path, except warn_duplicate_quality, which groups by quality (UHD, then HD, then SD) and sorts by path within each group. The validation pass uses the same shape under output/<drive>/<type>/validation-warnings.json, and the Plex commands under plex-warnings.json (`npm run plex:check`) and plex-log-warnings.json (`npm run plex:logs`) — plus copies under unfiltered/ when run with --no-ignore.

generated.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the file was written.

count.description: Total warnings collected. Equals the sum of every bucket's length. Excludes warnings silenced by ignored/<drive>/<type>.yaml.

by_type.description: Map of warning-type identifier to an array of rows. Keys are 'warn_*' identifiers matching toggles in rules/<type>.yaml under `checks`.

path.description: Library-relative path, forward-slash-normalized. Locations the user opens to fix the issue.

issue.description: Human-readable description of the issue. Includes a recommended fix when possible.

extension.description: Optional file extension. Only present for non-primary file warnings (warn_non_primary).
